title: LinguaX Arc: A Corpus Linguistics Toolkit in Your Pocket
author: Dr. Adnan Tahir
summary: Dr. Adnan Tahir explores offline corpus analysis on Android, proposes five classroom activities and discusses responsible use of a new research tool.
editorial_note: The original English PDF is reproduced unchanged. It discusses version 5.0 and records the author’s assessment as of October 2026; release details and plans are retained as written. The author’s relationship to the developer is disclosed in the PDF.
